data.body_html:
Imagine sipping chilled cava as the sun dips behind La Concha mountain, the Mediterranean turning gold and pink around you. A Marbella sunset champagne tapas cruise from Puerto Banús is the quintessential Costa del Sol evening—relaxed, elegant, and unforgettable. With a private boat, a licensed skipper, and all drinks and tapas included, you simply step aboard and let the evening unfold. Prices start from €749 for the Astondoa 40 (up to 9 guests) for a two-hour cruise, with no hidden extras. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or just soaking up Marbella's famous sunset, this experience delivers.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline faces west, offering spectacular sunset views over the water. Unlike crowded beach bars or restaurants, a private boat gives you an unobstructed panorama. The light changes every minute—from deep orange to soft lavender—and the sea breeze keeps you cool even on warm summer evenings. You'll cruise past landmarks like the Golden Mile, the dunes of Cabopino, and the cliffs of Cala del Faro, all bathed in twilight. It's a sensory experience that no land-based venue can match.

What's Included in Your Sunset Cruise

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Light tapas snacks are also provided. You don't need to bring anything except comfortable clothing and a camera. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m) costs €749 for 2 hours and accommodates up to 9 guests. For larger groups, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) is also available at the same price. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Which Boat Is Right for You?

For an intimate sunset cruise, the Astondoa 40 is a popular choice—elegant, spacious, and perfect for up to 9 guests. The Azimut 39 offers a similar experience for up to 11 guests. If you're celebrating with a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) includes a free jet ski and starts from €4,719 for 4 hours—ideal for a longer sunset adventure. Explore our full fleet to find your perfect match.

Typical Sunset Cruise Itinerary

You'll depart from Puerto Banús around 18:00 (adjustable by season). The skipper will take you west along the coast, past the Marbella Marina and the Golden Mile. You'll anchor near Cala Cortés or off the coast of Estepona for a swim if the weather permits. As the sun sets, your cava and tapas are served. The return to port is under the stars, with the marina lights reflecting on the water. Total duration: 2 to 3 hours.

Best Times for a Sunset Cruise

In summer (June–August), sunset is around 21:30, so a 19:00 departure works well. In spring and autumn (April–May, September–October), sunset is earlier—around 20:00—so aim for a 17:30 or 18:00 start. Winter sunsets can be as early as 18:00, but the light is still stunning. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially for weekends and holidays.

How to Book Your Sunset Champagne Tapas Cruise

Booking is simple. Choose your preferred boat from our fleet, then contact us via WhatsApp or the website. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, the price is fixed at €749 for 2 hours. For other boats like the Mangusta 80, pricing is on request. We'll confirm availability, departure time, and meeting point. A deposit secures your booking. All major payment methods accepted.
